LanguageData.PhobosSling_LiftGizmoDesc: Choose a vehicle parked outdoors within {CELLS} cells to carry hanging from the cargo hook. Today the hook lifts up to {CAPACITY} kg, the vehicle, its cargo and the people aboard together. When the helicopter takes off, the vehicle goes with it, and it is set down beside the helicopter where it lands.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_CancelGizmoDesc: Unhook {LOAD} and take off without it.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_NoHook: It has no cargo hook. A mechanic can fit one in the fittings and tunes.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_NoSlingSet: It has no sling set aboard. Load one, made at the vehicle parts bench.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_UnderOrders: {LOAD} is getting ready to leave with a caravan. Cancel the caravan, or let it leave, before lifting it.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_Hitched: {LOAD} is hitched to another vehicle. Unhitch it first.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_TooHeavy: {LOAD} weighs {WEIGHT} kg with what it carries, and the hook lifts {CAPACITY} kg today.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_LaunchWaitsForCrew: {LOAD} still waits for someone to hook it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ChosenCrew: {HELICOPTER} will lift {LOAD} once a colonist has hooked it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ChosenReady: {HELICOPTER} has {LOAD} on its hook and will lift it at take-off.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_LeftBehind: {LOAD} was not hooked up and stays behind.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_LeftBehindFar: {HELICOPTER} set off too far from {LOAD} to lift it, so it was left behind.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_StillFlying: {HELICOPTER} is still in the air. The load comes down once it has landed.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_Lifted: {HELICOPTER} lifts {LOAD} on its sling: {WEIGHT} kg. It will be set down beside the helicopter where it lands.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_CouldNotLift: The hook would not take {LOAD}. It stays where it stood.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SetDownGizmoDesc: Set {LOAD} down on the nearest clear open ground beside the helicopter. It is still on the hook because there was no room when the helicopter landed.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_NoSpot: There is no clear open ground near the helicopter to set {LOAD} down on. It stays on the hook until there is.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SetDownFailed: {LOAD} could not be set down and is still on the hook. Move the helicopter to open ground and set the load down again.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_InspectHooked: On the hook: {LOAD}, {WEIGHT} kg of {CAPACITY} kg today ({SHARE})
LanguageData.PhobosSling_InspectAwaitingCrew: Waiting for someone to hook it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingHeatDesc: A helicopter's cargo hook lifts 1% less for each degree above 15 °C, at most 30% less, as thinner hot air gives the rotor and engines less to work with. Off, a hook lifts its rated load in any weather.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingCrew: A ground crew hooks the load up
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingCrewDesc: A colonist walks to the chosen vehicle and hooks the strops on before the helicopter can lift it. Off, the helicopter hooks it up by itself.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingWeatherDesc: A load swings dangerously in strong wind, so no lift starts in a gale or a thunderstorm; the helicopter waits for calmer weather. Off, lifts go ahead in any weather.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingSlowFlight: Slung loads fly slower and burn more
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingSlowFlightDesc: A vehicle hanging under a helicopter drags at the air, so the flight is slower and costs more fuel for each stretch of ground crossed, and the range shown when choosing a destination is shorter. Off, a slung flight costs what an empty one does.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingReleaseDesc: The crew can let a load go over the world map, where it falls and lies as a wreck for a caravan to recover; and a helicopter that crashes drops its load, which lands hard. Off, there is no release, and a crash keeps the load to be set down beside the wreckage.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_Storm: A thunderstorm grounds the lift. Wait for it to pass.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_TooWindy: The wind is too strong to lift safely: {WIND} now, and a lift needs {LIMIT} or less. Wait for calmer weather.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ChooseSpot: {HELICOPTER} is down with {LOAD} on the hook. Choose where to set it down, or right-click to let the crew pick the nearest clear ground.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SpotTooFar: Too far from the helicopter: the load comes down within {CELLS} cells of it.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SpotBlocked: The load does not fit there: it needs open ground under the sky with nobody and nothing in the way.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_FellInCrash: {HELICOPTER} came down in a crash, and {LOAD} fell from its sling and landed hard: {HARM}.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_HarmShare: its parts lost about {SHARE} of their health, and anyone inside was hurt
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ReleaseGizmoDesc: Let {LOAD} go. It falls from cruising height and lands hard below, badly damaged, with anyone riding in it hurt or killed. It lies there as a wreck until a caravan reaches it. The helicopter flies on lighter.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ReleaseConfirm: Let {LOAD} fall? It will be badly damaged, and the {PEOPLE} people riding in it may be hurt or killed. It lies where it falls as a wreck for a caravan to recover.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ReleaseOff: The crew cannot release the load in flight.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ReleaseNoTile: There is nowhere open below for {LOAD} to fall. Fly on and try again over open country.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_Released: {HELICOPTER} let {LOAD} go. It fell and lies below as a wreck: send a caravan to recover it.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_WorldSlowFlight: Slowed by the load: {SPEED} of its speed, {FUEL} times the fuel over the same ground.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_WreckInspect: {LOAD} lies here where it fell, with {PEOPLE} people aboard.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_WreckReached: {CARAVAN} has reached {LOAD}. It is damaged from the fall: repair it, drive it, tow it or lift it home.
